themes.theme: No audit trail for AI-assisted edits
themes.requirement: Append-only log of every AI-assisted edit with author, time and change, exportable by an administrator.
themes.representative_quote: Without an exportable audit log this fails our internal review.

changes.title: Exportable audit log of AI-assisted edits
changes.requirement: Append-only log of every AI-assisted edit with author, time and change, exportable by an administrator.
changes.rationale: A control failure raised by three accounts and first in the commercial ranking. No study observation yet shows how the record is used in a review.
changes.next_decision: Do the two risk teams that raised the point accept the export format?

themes.theme: Can't restrict who approves sensitive matters
themes.requirement: Approval permissions scoped by practice group and matter value.
themes.representative_quote: We need approval permissions by practice group.

changes.title: Role-based approval permissions
changes.requirement: Approval permissions scoped by practice group and matter value.
changes.rationale: A control gap raised by two accounts. The rule customers need (role, group, value) is not yet specified by any of them.
changes.next_decision: Which approval rule do the two accounts need: by role, by group or by matter value?

themes.theme: Citations not always traceable to the source
themes.requirement: Each list item carries the clause number and a link to the clause.
themes.representative_quote: I can't trust a summary I can't click through to the clause.

changes.title: Clause reference on every list item
changes.requirement: Each list item carries the clause number and a link to the clause.
changes.rationale: A verification gap seen in one task session and raised by two account feedback items.
changes.next_decision: Hold the overdue follow-up session, then assess.

themes.requirement: Show a short legend for item statuses at the top of every issues list.
themes.representative_quote: The first session is great, then people drift back to old habits.

changes.title: Status legend on the issues list
changes.requirement: Show a short legend for item statuses at the top of every issues list.
changes.rationale: Cheap to try. The observations do not show whether wording or a missing definition causes the misreading.
changes.next_decision: Withdraw the legend and test a status that names the clauses read on each item?

themes.requirement: Export of active users and runs by practice group and period.
themes.representative_quote: I'd like to see which teams are actually using it each week.

changes.title: Self-serve usage export
changes.requirement: Export of active users and runs by practice group and period.
changes.rationale: A convenience item. No blocked workflow was observed, and the two quality and control items take the same team's capacity.
changes.next_decision: Revisit once the audit log is released.
